name: historia_zonas_musica
prompt: Playful, elegant game-show suspense instrumental for an Instagram story quiz, 112 BPM. Starts instantly with a catchy ticking clock and pizzicato strings hook, light Caribbean dembow percussion underneath, rising tension with a drum roll from second 5 to second 10, a fun bright brass sting at second 11, then a short groovy outro that ends cleanly at 15 seconds. Polished, modern, fun, not cheesy.
